description: Auto-approve the installment of a funded project only when the funding agreement, the milestone report and the accountability report refer to the same agreement, the report covers the agreed milestone and was delivered within its window, previous installments are accounted for with no open findings, the amount fits the milestone amount, and the amount is within the automated actor's autonomy limit; otherwise escalate to the human approver with one reason per failed condition, in the order listed.
dates: calendar dates YYYY-MM-DD; comparisons are inclusive

conditions.check: each required document kind is submitted exactly once

conditions.reason: milestone differs between agreement and report
milestone delivered outside the agreed window
open findings in the accountability report

notEvaluated: a condition that reads a missing or duplicated document is not evaluated
